Gold Purity Guide

Understand 24K, 22K, 21K, 20K & 18K Gold

About 99.9% gold

24 Karat

Very high-purity gold and a common benchmark for comparing fine-gold market prices.

About 91.6% gold

22 Karat

A high-purity category frequently used for traditional gold jewellery.

About 87.5% gold

21 Karat

A gold-alloy category that customers may compare when checking jewellery prices.

About 83.3% gold

20 Karat

Contains a lower proportion of gold than 21K and 22K, so its reference value is different.

75% gold

18 Karat

Contains 75% gold mixed with other metals to create a harder alloy for jewellery.

Compare the same karat, weight unit and market timing before evaluating two gold quotations.

Market Information

What Affects the Gold Rate in Sargodha?

Gold prices in Sargodha can change as local and international market conditions move. These factors help explain why a quotation may differ from an earlier published reference.

International Gold Price

Changes in the international gold market can influence the base value used by local bullion markets.

USD / PKR Exchange Rate

Currency movements can change the rupee value of gold traded internationally.

Local Market Conditions

Trading activity, supply, demand and local market quotations can affect the rate available to buyers and sellers.

Purity & Weight

24K, 22K, 21K, 20K and 18K gold have different gold content, while weight determines the total metal value.

Practical Buying Guide

How to Compare a Gold Price Quote

Confirm the Karat

Compare 24K with 24K, 22K with 22K and the same for other purities. Do not compare different karats as if they were equal.

Confirm the Weight

Check whether the rate is quoted per tola, per 10 grams or per gram, and confirm the measured weight.

Ask for a Breakdown

For finished jewellery, ask the seller to explain the gold value, workmanship, stones, wastage and any other charges.

Check the Time

Check the date and time of a published price. A static reference can differ from a later market quotation.

Gold Rate FAQs

What is the gold rate today in Sargodha?

The 22K rate is Rs. 389,583, the 21K rate is Rs. 371,875, the 20K rate is Rs. 354,167 and the 18K rate is Rs. 318,750 per tola. These are dated reference prices, not guaranteed live buying or selling quotations. Confirm the current market rate before a transaction.

What is today's gold rate in Sargodha per gram?

For the dated 12 November 2026 reference, 24K gold is approximately Rs. 36,437 per gram. The page's per-gram and per-10-gram values are calculated from the per-tola reference using approximately 11.664 grams per tola and rounded to the nearest rupee.

What is the Sargodha gold rate today for 21K gold?

The 21K reference for 12 November 2026 is Rs. 371,875 per tola, approximately Rs. 318,823 per 10 grams and Rs. 31,882 per gram.

What is the 24K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The 24K reference for 12 November 2026 is Rs. 425,000 per tola, approximately Rs. 364,369 per 10 grams and Rs. 36,437 per gram.

What is the 22K gold rate today in Sargodha?

The 22K reference for 12 November 2026 is Rs. 389,583 per tola, approximately Rs. 334,005 per 10 grams and Rs. 33,400 per gram.

How many grams are in one tola of gold?

One tola is approximately 11.664 grams. The conversion is useful when comparing a per-tola gold rate with a per-gram or per-10-gram quotation.

Is the gold rate the same as the final jewellery price?

No. The displayed gold rate is a metal-value reference. The final jewellery price may also include workmanship, design, stone work, wastage and other charges agreed with the jeweller.

Why can two websites show different gold rates?

Published figures can reflect different update times, market locations, valuation methods or buy/sell sides. Compare the date, purity and weight unit before treating two numbers as equivalent.
